info.name: SMemories - media
info.description: Photo upload, list, download and delete (T-009, T-046). Run from the postman/ directory (newman run media.postman_collection.json --working-dir .) against an API started with SMEM_ENV=dev and a reachable MinIO (make up). Each run registers 2 users (limit 5 per hour per IP; restart the API or raise SMEM_RATE_REGISTER_PER_HOUR before a third run in the hour). Run the whole collection in order: Edge cases reuses the two users of the Full flow. Not covered here because a collection cannot generate files: the 11 MiB size cap (413), quotas and the upload rate limit; the Go integration tests cover them.

exec: // Runs before every request in the folder; generate only before the first one so the whole flow shares one pair of accounts.

item.name: 4. A uploads a JPEG with GPS EXIF and orientation 6 (200x100 becomes 100x200)
5. A downloads the display version: right headers, no EXIF/GPS left
6b. A downloads the print size (1800 px long edge)
8. A sets the cover and the profile photo
11. B deleting A's photo answers 204 but deletes nothing
16. The cover and profile photo were cleared
17. A uploads a PNG with transparency (stays PNG)
18. The PNG is served as image/png
20. A lists with limit=1: the newest photo first, and a cursor

exec: pm.test('item shape: no storage keys, hashes or URLs', () => { pm.expect(m).to.have.all.keys('id','width','height','bytes','uploader_kind','created_at'); pm.expect(m.uploader_kind).to.eql('owner'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/object_key|thumb_key|sha256|yearbooks\//); });

item.name: 21. A pages with the cursor: the older photo, no next cursor
22. A lists with the defaults: both photos, newest first

exec: pm.test('empty array, not null', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({media: [], next_cursor: null}));

item.name: 25. A deletes the photo the cursor points at
26. The old cursor still works: the older photo

exec: pm.test('the older photo, nothing skipped or repeated', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().media.map(m => m.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get('mediaId2')]); pm.expect(pm.response.json().next_cursor).to.be.null; });

28. The photo of the deleted yearbook is gone

E34. Largest limit with a cursor below every photo - 200, empty

exec: pm.test('never lists a photo of another yearbook', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().media.map(m => m.id).filter(i => i !== pm.collectionVariables.get('mediaIdB'))).to.eql([]));
